job.title: AI Engineer
job.description:
ParetoLabs is looking for a passionate (Senior) AI Engineer to join our growing team in Zurich.
In this role, you will design, build, and run production-grade AI applications powered by large language models, agentic AI, RAG, and multimodal technologies. You will work across the full engineering lifecycle: from architecture and backend development to cloud deployment and continuous improvement and help shape AI solutions used by leading Swiss companies across different industries.
You will be part of a small, experienced team where you can take real ownership, work directly on customer-facing products, and turn the latest advances in AI into reliable applications used in the real world.
About ParetoLabs
ParetoLabs is a Zurich-based AI software company building customized AI applications for conversation, knowledge, and process automation. We develop solutions ranging from intelligent assistants and enterprise search to agentic AI and next-generation voice applications.
Since 2023, we have been combining cutting-edge AI technologies with the security, reliability, and integration requirements of Swiss companies. As a Microsoft for Startups partner, we work closely with our customers to bring AI solutions from idea to production.
Aufgaben
Design, build, and continuously improve production-grade AI applications powered by LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and multimodal AI.
Develop robust Python backend services, APIs, and integrations that connect AI capabilities with enterprise systems and data sources.
Build intelligent agents and end-to-end AI workflows capable of reasoning, using tools, interacting with APIs, and automating complex user requests.
Take ownership of bringing AI solutions into production, including testing, deployment, monitoring, observability, and continuous optimization.
Design scalable and reliable cloud architectures and contribute to the evolution of our shared AI platform and engineering standards.
Evaluate and integrate new models, frameworks, and AI technologies where they create real value for our products and customers.

job.title: Intern – Python Development & Data Analysis
job.description:
Company Description
At PQ Technologies AG (PQT), we build data processing solutions for the financial industry, working with both structured and unstructured data. Our focus is the End-to-End Compliance & Risk process at banks and financial institutions, in particular Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money-Laundering (AML).
We are a multidisciplinary team of 10–15 people in Zurich, combining deep domain expertise in Compliance & Risk with strong engineering capabilities. Our software runs inside our clients' critical processes at leading financial institutions, tested and relied on daily.
Role Description
We are looking for an intern for a paid, 6-month fixed-term internship, supporting the development of data processing and evaluation systems on top of our Nucleus Compliance & Risk Engine, for leading financial institutions. You'll work closely with our engineers and our Compliance & Risk specialists, and contribute to projects that go live with our clients.
Key responsibilities
Develop (Python) code for data processing and evaluation on our Nucleus Compliance & Risk Engine
Perform data analysis on real datasets in the KYC/AML domain
Support the delivery teams with analysis, testing, documentation and preparation of client sessions
What you will gain
Experience in delivering production-ready code
Practical experience with LLM supported applications in production
Insight into B2B customer communication with regulated financial institutions, and into how client projects are delivered
Direct mentoring from senior engineers and real ownership of your work
Location & commitment
Hybrid — Zurich office, with remote days
Fixed-term internship, 6 months, 70–100%
Start date: 1 September 2026
CHF 4,200 gross per month (paid internship)
No relocation support and no visa sponsorship; travel is limited to occasional client meetings
Extension or permanent role possible after the internship
Qualifications
Currently enrolled in a BSc or MSc in a STEM field at a Swiss university, or a recent graduate
Programming knowledge and experience in Python
A good understanding of algorithms and data structures
Ability to work in a dynamic environment with different types of duties
Valid permission to work in Switzerland
The drive to work independently and pick up new things across different areas
Nice to have — experience working on code collaboratively
No prior compliance or finance knowledge is expected. We care more about attitude and curiosity than a long list of prior experience — we're there to support you, and we're looking for self-starters.
